name: 1M LED Pixel Bar
notes: Clen's RGBW LED pixel bar with the round diffuser (RES-039, the maintainer's private notes). Cross-section from Clen's bar drawing: an 18 x 18.5 mm housing under a 30.2 mm diffuser cut flat; the flat's chord, 2*sqrt(15.1^2 - 11.9^2) = 18.6 mm, agrees with the 18 mm housing (docs/studio/domain-model.md:58).
